opening.argument: The video explains a practical process for submitting photographs to established stock-image platforms, beginning with where viewers can sell their work and how to upload it. It does not present a guaranteed return: images must be reviewed, and approval depends on being original and good quality. Earnings arise only if an image is bought, after which the stated payment goes to the contributor’s bank account. The displayed Shutterstock contributor page and dashboard show ordinary upload and earnings features, including no stated amount rather than a promised sum. The video also states that it is not sponsored, providing additional context for the platform links and keeping the material within education and operational guidance rather than a deceptive or harmful scheme.

citations.quote: In this video I will tell you how to sell your photo and where you can sell your photo.
After that, the company will review your images.
If your images are original and of good quality, then they will approve your image.
And if any image buys you, then it will be your earning.
This is not a sponsored video.
